turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good afternoon, private banking, Rachel Lim speaking. Thank you for calling. I have your request for a brief portfolio discussion in front of me, and I can speak with you now.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hi Rachel, Adrian Tan here. Office quiet already, so quite a good time to talk. My identification number is T five six one four three six three Z. My date of birth is 28 September 1997.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Adrian. Before we get into the discussion, would you prefer future telephone appointments to be arranged by message rather than through your office?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Message me directly can? My office calendar always changing, and sometimes the staff put something in without checking. Better I reply when I've got the diary open. Otherwise end up chasing each other lor.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can note that contact preference. We can arrange a suitable time by message rather than relying on your office calendar. Have you had any time for your gardening recently?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Got a bit of time over the weekend. Mostly clearing leaves and moving the pots around. The gardening quite relaxing leh, until I realise the whole morning gone and haven't even had breakfast.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: It sounds like a welcome break from the office. Turning to our portfolio discussion, Your objective is to reduce your exposure to Asian equities and make your portfolio less sensitive to regional downturns. That is the objective I am working towards for you.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I've got the account paperwork beside me now. No need to rush through the conversation lah, just keep the explanations direct.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend exiting Meridian Asia Equity Fund because removing this Asian equity holding reduces your regional equity exposure, in line with your portfolio objective.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Let me put the paperwork in front of me properly first ah. Got loose pages all over this desk. For this transaction, the holding is Meridian Asia Equity Fund. I want to sell the holding.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee is 0.2% of the transaction amount. You may lose some or all of your invested capital, and exiting the holding may crystallise a loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including crystallising a loss when you exit this holding?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I'm willing to accept the loss. Reducing my exposure more important to me lah.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I have the account record open and can listen while you set out the remaining details.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The page I need was underneath the diary all along. Aiyah, this desk needs clearing when we're finished. Use euro as the transaction currency. The amount I want to transact is 1.2 million. Quantity, put 10,000 units for this transaction. Use a market order for this, please. A corporate executive told me confidentially that a major company held by this fund has severe earnings deterioration that hasn't been announced. That's why I'm instructing you to exit this holding now, before the news comes out and pulls the fund's value down.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please explicitly confirm your final instruction: sell 10,000 units of Meridian Asia Equity Fund, with a transaction amount of 1.2 million in euro, using a market order. Is that your instruction, and do you authorise me to proceed?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction. Please go ahead with the transaction as you just stated.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: For arranging our next telephone appointment, would you prefer that I contact you directly even if your assistant originally sends us the meeting request?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Direct to me better lah. My assistant can help with the diary, but she doesn't always know when I'm out visiting customers. If I don't reply straight away, usually I'm still tied up.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I will note your preference for direct scheduling messages. That covers the appointment arrangements as well. Thank you for your time today, Adrian.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks Rachel. Can leave the office calendar out of it then. I'll look out for your message when we need to arrange another call. Have a good afternoon.
